_comment: Hand-authored stub in the vitest JSON reporter's shape, to test check_consistency's vitest-format handling. Unlike runs/pytest-c*.json (genuine pytest --json-report output), this file is not produced by an actual vitest run — the mini fixture has no dispatch/package.json, so bench/runs.py never invokes vitest for it. The fullName field's single-space join (not ' > ') matches genuine vitest 5.0.2 output, confirmed 2026-09-28 by capturing real `npx vitest run --reporter=json` output from spike/system/dispatch; deliberately kept single-space here so it does NOT match truth's ' > '-joined location, proving check_consistency reconstructs ancestorTitles+title itself rather than trusting fullName.
